name: media
description: Image processing in Rust: dimensions and format, resize (fit inside or cover and crop) with format conversion.

capabilities.name: image_info
capabilities.description: Reads an image's width, height and format without decoding pixels.
capabilities.rules: data is the image file, base64 encoded. Formats: jpeg, png, webp, gif, bmp; any other (heic, avif, tiff) fails with the error code unsupported_format.

capabilities.name: image_resize
capabilities.description: Resizes an image to fit within width and height (aspect ratio kept; one of them may be omitted), or with fit cover to fill exactly width by height, cropped around the centre, and encodes it as jpeg, png or webp.
capabilities.rules: fit contain (the default): give width, height or both; the image is scaled to fit inside, never enlarged. fit cover: give both; the result is exactly that size, scaled to fill (enlarged when smaller) and the overflow cropped around the centre, for square avatars and thumbnails. format defaults to the input format when it is jpeg, png or webp, else jpeg. quality (1-100) applies to jpeg only. An input format the pack cannot decode (heic, avif, tiff) fails with the error code unsupported_format: keep the original.
